notes.title: Power Ups and Small Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Added power ups to the levels. Position is randomly generated, as is the time when they appear.

-Heart - Increases max HP
-Snowflake - Freezes enemies, and disables input for a short period.
-Lightning Bolt - Damages enemies
-"Wiggly Worm" - Increases damage output

Also fixed a few UI bugs, and some random ones I can't remember.
